'''Scroll of Biting''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Glory}}. It appears in groups of 3 (weak) or 4 (normal), each starting on a different move.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Scroll of Biting}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Chomp
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (14;{{Asc2|9|16}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = More Teeth
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Chew
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (5;{{Asc2|9|6}}) damage 2 times.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Each Scroll of Biting starts on a different move in the cycle. The pattern is: {{Int2|Scroll of Biting|Chomp}}, then {{Int2|Scroll of Biting|More Teeth}}, then {{Int2|Scroll of Biting|Chew}}.

After {{Int2|Scroll of Biting|Chew}}, it randomly picks either {{Int2|Scroll of Biting|Chomp}} (cannot repeat) or {{Int2|Scroll of Biting|Chew}} (weight 2), then continues the cycle from that point.

== Notes ==
* If the Scroll of Biting deals unblocked damage to {{KW2|Osty}}, neither he nor the player loses any max HP from {{BD2|Paper Cuts}}.
* If {{R2|Tungsten Rod}} reduces the unblocked damage taken from 1 to 0 (for example, if a '''Scroll of Biting''' deals 14 damage to a player with 13 {{KW2|Block}}) then the player will not lose max HP.
* If the Scroll of Biting dies from reflected damage such as {{BD2|Thorns}} or {{BD2|Flame Barrier}} while dealing unblocked damage to the player, the player will not lose any max HP from {{BD2|Paper Cuts}}.
